segments.name: Building Systems
segments.description: Provides comprehensive building infrastructure solutions for data centers and other critical facilities.
segments.evidence: The Building Systems segment specializes in providing comprehensive building infrastructure solutions, including electrical, energy management, security, and fire safety systems for data centers and other critical facilities .

revenueModel.text: Customers, mainly telecommunications providers, pay Dycom under master service agreements and other contracts with discrete pricing for individual tasks, with revenue recognized over time as services are performed.
revenueModel.evidence: We perform a significant amount of our services under master service agreements and other contracts that contain customer-specified service requirements.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026, following the acquisition of Power Solutions, the Company added the Building Systems segment as a new reportable segment.
changes.evidence: Beginning in fiscal 2026, the Company reports the results of the Building Systems segment separately as a reportable segment.
